subject: Three different friendly prehistoric marine reptiles grouped in a natural coastal habitat, all smiling triumphantly.

foreground.marine_reptile_1: Protostega: Three-quarter view, proud happy smile, large paddle-like flippers, beautifully patterned leathery shell carapace, positioned prominently on a sandy shore.
foreground.marine_reptile_2: Nothosaurus: Three-quarter view, cheerful smile, webbed feet resting on wet pebbles, sleek seal-like body contours, positioned beside Protostega near the water's edge.
foreground.marine_reptile_3: Halisaurus: Three-quarter view, brave happy smile, long streamlined tail fin visible, looking out from the shallow surf in the background with a contented expression.

composition.background: Open, sunny prehistoric shallow tropical lagoon beach with a deep sand-hole nest containing perfectly spherical matte-white eggs, distant coral reef crests breaking the surface, and a vibrant clear blue sky. Celebratory, light atmosphere.
composition.grouping: Marine reptiles are posed along the sunny tidal interface in a way that conveys happiness and success, looking out warmly at the player.

caption_1.style: Bright coral-pink, thick 3D mixed-case block letters, positioned top-center.

caption_2.style: Shiny gold, bold 3D mixed-case block letters, positioned clearly below 'Marine Eggs!', with a subtle celebratory sparkle effect. Text is slightly textured, like polished gold.

visual_logic.overall_mood: Celebratory, rewarding, successful. Emphasizes the positive educational outcome of completing the marine reptiles matching game.
visual_logic.color_palette: Bright sunny yellows, intense coral-reef turquoise and teals, warm golden beach sand, with the coral-pink and gold captions standing out sharply.
